subject: Physics
plan_title: Teaching Plan (Board-order, dual CET + NDA weight)
notes: Same Physics logic as XI: board-order spine, dual CET + NDA weight (NDA Physics is a real co-driver, esp. Optics/E&M/Modern Physics/Thermo).
16 board chapters in board order, grouped into 5 phases (mechanics & thermal -> oscillations & waves -> electrostatics & current -> magnetism & induction -> modern physics & semiconductors).

NCERT XI/XII split differs from Maharashtra: board XII chapters 1-6 (Rotational Dynamics, Fluids, Kinetic Theory, Thermodynamics, Oscillations, Superposition) are NCERT Class 11; chapters 7-16 (optics/electricity/magnetism/modern) are NCERT Class 12.

guiding_principles.meaning: XII Physics is the heart of both MHT-CET (Electrostatics 171, AC 138, Rotational 137...) and NDA (Optics, E&M, Modern Physics). Board order; both CET and NDA columns carry real weight.
NDA Physics tests wave optics, electricity & magnetism, modern physics, thermodynamics, fluids and waves at ~Class 11-12 level. Populated NDA column, not a basic overlay.
Mechanics & Thermal -> Oscillations & Waves -> Electrostatics & Current -> Magnetism & Induction -> Modern Physics & Semiconductors.

phases.name: Mechanics & Thermal Physics
phases.blurb: Rotational dynamics, fluids, kinetic theory & radiation, thermodynamics.

phases.name: Oscillations & Waves
phases.blurb: SHM, superposition of waves, and wave optics.

phases.name: Magnetism & Induction
phases.blurb: Magnetic fields, magnetic materials, electromagnetic induction, AC circuits.

phases.name: Modern Physics & Semiconductors
phases.blurb: Dual nature, atoms & nuclei, semiconductor devices.

units.title: Rotational Dynamics
units.why_here: Circular motion, moment of inertia & theorems, angular momentum, rolling. High CET (137). NCERT places rotational motion in Class 11.

units.title: Mechanical Properties of Fluids
units.why_here: Pressure, buoyancy, surface tension, viscosity, Bernoulli. High CET (129, Surface Tension 80); NDA Fluids 23. NCERT Class 11.

units.title: Kinetic Theory of Gases and Radiation
units.why_here: Kinetic theory, RMS speed, equipartition, mean free path, radiation. CET 86; NDA Heat 39 (partial). NCERT Class 11.

units.title: Thermodynamics
units.why_here: Laws of thermodynamics, processes, Carnot engine. CET 86; NDA Heat & Thermodynamics 39. NCERT Class 11.

units.title: Oscillations
units.why_here: SHM kinematics, energy, pendulum, spring-mass. High CET (116); NDA Oscillations 13. NCERT Class 11.

units.title: Superposition of Waves
units.why_here: Progressive & stationary waves, beats, pipes, Doppler, interference. High CET (129); NDA Sound 34. NCERT Class 11 (Waves).

units.title: Wave Optics
units.why_here: Huygens, interference (YDSE), diffraction, polarisation. High CET (130, YDSE 73); NDA optics (wave slice). NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Electrostatics
units.why_here: Gauss's law applications, electric potential, capacitance, dielectrics. Highest CET chapter (171); NDA E&M. NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Current Electricity
units.why_here: Kirchhoff, Wheatstone, potentiometer, meters. CET 93; NDA E&M (resistors/devices/power). NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Magnetic Fields due to Electric Current
units.why_here: Magnetic force, field of current, force on conductor, torque on loop. CET 104; NDA E&M (magnetism). NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Magnetic Materials
units.why_here: Magnetisation, susceptibility, dia/para/ferromagnetism, hysteresis. CET 35; NDA light. NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Electromagnetic Induction
units.why_here: Faraday/Lenz, self & mutual inductance, motional EMF. High CET (125); NDA light. NCERT Class 12.

units.title: AC Circuits
units.why_here: AC generator, LCR circuits, resonance, power, LC oscillations. High CET (138); NDA light. NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
units.why_here: Photoelectric effect, Einstein's equation, de Broglie waves. CET 87; NDA Modern Physics (photoelectric). NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Structure of Atoms and Nuclei
units.why_here: Atomic models, Bohr, hydrogen spectrum, radioactivity, fission/fusion. CET 91; NDA Modern Physics (atoms/nuclei). NCERT Class 12.

units.title: Semiconductor Devices
units.why_here: Rectifiers, filters, Zener/LED, transistors, logic gates. High CET (133); NDA light. NCERT Class 12.
